name: energy-drink-ratings
description: Label facts and community ratings for 1,000+ energy drinks: caffeine, sugar, calories, sweeteners, and what drinkers think.

interface.longDescription:
Energy Drink Ratings is an independent catalog of more than 1,000 energy drinks, with label facts (caffeine, sugar, calories, serving size, sweeteners, ingredients) and ratings from a community of drinkers.

Ask how much caffeine or sugar a drink has, compare two or more drinks, or describe what you want ("zero sugar, fruity, under 200 mg") and get matches ranked by real community ratings. Every answer shows how many ratings the score is based on and links to the drink page for the full reviews.

The connector is read-only. It does not sell anything, return affiliate links, or give medical advice; caffeine figures are what the label says, not a safe amount for any particular person. Rating a drink and logging it in the caffeine tracker happen on energydrinkratings.com.
defaultPrompt: How much caffeine and sugar is in Celsius Sparkling Orange?
Compare Bang Purple Haze and Celsius Sparkling Orange.
Find me a zero-sugar fruity energy drink under 200 mg of caffeine.

positive.description: Look up one drink's label facts
positive.prompt: How much caffeine and sugar is in Celsius Sparkling Orange?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 200 mg caffeine, 0 g sugar, 10 calories and 12 fl oz, the community rating with the number of ratings it is based on, and a link to the drink page.

positive.prompt: Compare Bang Purple Haze and Celsius Sparkling Orange.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows both drinks side by side (Bang Purple Haze 300 mg caffeine, 0 g sugar, 0 cal; Celsius Sparkling Orange 200 mg, 0 g sugar, 10 cal), each with its rating, rating count and drink-page link.

positive.prompt: Find me a zero-sugar fruity energy drink with under 200 mg of caffeine.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the total number of matches and up to 10 drinks, each zero sugar and under 200 mg caffeine with its flavor family, ranked by community rating (with rating count) where rated, each with a link.

positive.description: What drinkers say about a drink
positive.prompt: What do people say about Alani Nu Cosmic Stardust?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns label facts (200 mg caffeine, 0 g sugar), the rating with its count, a one-line summary of what raters say, and a link to the full reviews. A drink with too few written reviews gets no summary.

positive.prompt: Which Celsius drinks are in the Energy Drink Ratings catalog?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 Celsius drinks with links to their drink pages. If a name has no entry, reports that no drinks were found instead of inventing one.

negative.description: Asks the plugin to buy a drink. The plugin is read-only, has no purchase tool and must not claim to order or ship anything; it may share the drink's label facts and link to its page.
negative.prompt: Order me a case of Celsius Sparkling Orange.

negative.description: Asks the plugin to write a rating. The plugin is read-only and cannot submit a rating; it may offer the drink page link where the person can rate it themselves.
negative.prompt: Rate Bang Purple Haze 5 stars for me.

negative.description: Out-of-scope question. This is not an energy drink question, so the plugin is not used and does not claim to answer it.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Philadelphia tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It returns read-only label facts, community ratings and links to our own drink pages; it has no checkout, prices or affiliate links.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Four read-only tools (search_drinks, get_drink, compare_drinks, find_drinks) over the Energy Drink Ratings catalog. No account or sign-in.
